split_protocol.split_unit: geometry; all loading trajectories from a geometry stay together
split_protocol.primary_endpoint: full-cycle free rollout completion, no inverted endpoint elements; residual at comparable displacement RMSE
split_protocol.calibration: 20 independent geometries with one independently uniform amplitude[.9,1.1]/timing[.95,1.05] waveform each; joint all-node/all-time conformal90/95%
split_protocol.test: four new geometries and iid uniform waveform descriptors matching calibration; additional four held-out load-shift trajectories on those test geometries analysed separately
split_protocol.shift: four combined geometry/loading-shift trajectories plus four loading-only shifts; no conformal guarantee
split_protocol.solver: generalized-alpha dt5ms variant, full200 steps0.005 through1s; 10ms attempt failed and is retained; strict positive SNES reason/residual/J gates
split_protocol.OOD: input domain geometry box[.95,1.05]^2 and amplitude[.9,1.1],timing[.95,1.05]; reject outside, also reject inverted/nonfinite predictions; exact FE fallback
split_protocol.limited_data: one labelled training geometry/two trajectories and own train-only POD; all four training geometries provide input geometry/load descriptors for physics collocation, unlabelled displacement/history arrays not read; baseline sees identical inputs but no residual loss; same validation labels/budgets
split_protocol.protocol_amendment: Before any calibration/test generation or label access: make calibration and primary test exchangeable and increase calibration20 for finite corrected95% radius; train/validation cases unchanged
split_protocol.convergence_tolerance: pre-evaluation1percent relative space-time volume-L2 for temporal and spatial sensitivity; report failures; two spatial levels do not establish asymptotic convergence
split_protocol.spatial_convergence_retry: refined5ms nonlinear solve failed/slow near.25s; compare coarse/fine at2.5ms, retain failed5ms trajectory; primary5ms ML cohort unchanged
